text.es: Varios tutores elogian la disposición y destreza de médicos como el Dr. Gabriel Gutiérrez y el Dr. Diego Rivera, reconociendo su preparación técnica en momentos críticos de la madrugada. text.en: Several pet owners praise the dedication and skill of clinicians such as Dr. Gabriel Gutiérrez and Dr. Diego Rivera, recognizing their readiness during late-night emergencies. However, one review describes a lack of empathy and inattention from the on-duty staff when handling an urgent trauma case.

text.en: Testimonials emphasize timely interventions that saved the lives of dogs and cats in Azcapotzalco, including emergency surgeries for pyometra in senior patients and stabilization of severe pneumonia. title.en: Inpatient animal care with mixed feedback

text.es: La mayoría de los usuarios aprecia el trato amable y cuidadoso hacia perros y gatos durante su estancia médica o recuperación. Sin embargo, un cliente reportó negligencia en el aseo y supervisión de su mascota hospitalizada, quejándose de que no la asistieron debidamente para hacer sus necesidades mientras recibía suero.
text.en: Most pet guardians appreciate the gentle and attentive handling of dogs and cats during clinical evaluations and post-surgical recovery. In contrast, one reviewer reported inadequate hygiene and supervision during inpatient care, complaining that their dog was not helped with bathroom needs while on IV fluids.
